messages.subject: GSoC 2016 Final Evaluations due soon!
messages.body_plain:
Final student evaluations are due in 3 days.

About half of R GSoC mentors have not yet filled out the evaluation.

Please complete these ASAP.

Google requires all evaluations to be filled out by the organization, or
we may risk not being accepted in subsequent years.

Approximately two hours before they are due, I will fill in any
remaining evaluations and fail your students.  (I've never had to do
this, so please cooperate and get it done)

Mentors:  please contact me if you need assistance

Students: please confirm with your mentors that they have filled out
your final evaluation.  Your mentors are not allowed to tell you what
the evaluation is, per Google rules.  Only Google is allowed to
communicate results.

Please do not hesitate to contact me with any questions or concerns.

Regards,

Brian

--
